title: [Day 04] Incremental DOM mutations
text:
Part 3 is in as tests only. There is no implementation commit: every listed case already passed on the Part 2 code, so nothing in production changed.

What the tests prove, with no code changes:
- `insertBefore` in the middle records `parentId` of the list and `nextId` of the following sibling.
- An append that becomes the last child records `nextId: null`.
- A masked element added later does not record its text. A select inside it omits `value` and `selected`, so a starred option value is not matchable to the choice. A blocked element added in that same turn omits its text and title.
- A password typed into a new input never appears. The value property does not emit a mutation. The value attribute, including one set again later, is dropped. A child text node on that input is dropped too.

Checks that passed: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`.

Left open: Parts 4 and 5 (the rebuild helper and the seeded fuzz test).
